input: Book a slot at the local ceramics kiln

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Kiln type (e.g. electric, gas, wood, raku) determines which facilities are relevant and what firing process to book.
Whether this is for the user alone or a group affects how many slots or how much kiln space needs to be reserved.
The specific date and time window the user needs affects availability and which facility to target first.
Budget for the firing fee will determine which studios or community kilns are viable options.
Knowing whether the user already has a specific studio in mind vs. needing help finding one changes the first action entirely.
The stage of the work (bisque vs. glaze firing) affects temperature, duration, and the type of slot to book.
Understanding what a successful outcome looks like — confirmed booking, shortlist of options, or a booking script — shapes how far the plan needs to go.

gold.taskTitle: Book a local ceramics kiln slot
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to reserve a firing slot at a local ceramics kiln facility.

questions.title: Which type of kiln firing do you need?
questions.description: Identify the kiln type required — electric, gas, raku, wood-fired, or other — as this determines which facilities can be booked.

questions.title: Is this booking just for you or a group?
questions.description: Clarify whether one person's work or multiple people's pieces need to be fired, as this affects how much kiln space to reserve.

questions.title: What date or timeframe do you need the slot?
questions.description: Establish the target date, deadline, or general window so availability at local studios can be checked accordingly.

questions.title: What is your budget for the firing fee?
questions.description: Determine a comfortable price range so only financially viable kiln facilities are considered.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific studio in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preferred or known facility, or whether they need help identifying and comparing local options first.

questions.title: Is this a bisque firing or a glaze firing?
questions.description: Clarify the stage of the work being fired, as bisque and glaze firings require different temperatures, durations, and slot types.

questions.title: What does a successful outcome look like to you?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants a confirmed booking made, a shortlist of studios to choose from, or guidance on how to book themselves.
